item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.

turns.text: can you make a post with this pic

dialog.agent:
I can make that. The sneaker will stay exactly as it is in your photo. I just need two answers first:

1. **What should change in the picture?** For example, swap the messy room for a clean studio background, put the shoe on a street or outdoor scene, or add some styling.
2. **Where will you post it?** Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print or somewhere else?

Also, do you want any words on the post, like a brand name, price or slogan? If so, send them exactly as you want them to appear.
dialog.why: The assistant asks what should change, where it will be posted, and what wording to include, then waits for the answers.
dialog.user: nothing really, just keep it how it looks. dont change anything

turns.agent:
Since you don't want anything changed, I didn't run any edits. Running your photo through the image tool would mean redrawing it, so the shoe could come back slightly different, and that would spend credits for no reason. Your photo can go up as the post just as it is.

Here are a few captions you can use with it:

1. **Clean. Simple. Goes with everything. 🤍👟**
2. **Fresh pair, fresh start. White leather low-tops that never miss.**
3. **Your new everyday sneaker. Minimal design, all-day comfort. 🤍**
4. **Less is more. #whitesneakers #minimalstyle #everydaykicks**

If you'd like, I can also:
- **Make a version sized for a platform:** square for an Instagram feed, or tall (9:16) for Stories or TikTok.
- **Add text on the image,** like a brand name, price or "New Drop." Just send the exact words.
- **Turn it into a short video post** with a slow camera move around the shoe.
